1	"""Single-file SQL query layer.
2	
3	Public API:
4	
5	* :func:`query_file` -- run a ``SELECT ... FROM input [WHERE ...]`` query
6	  against one columnar file and return a :class:`~columnar_analytics.format.Table`
7	* :class:`QuerySyntaxError` -- lexical / grammatical errors
8	* :class:`QueryValidationError` -- unknown columns, wrong table name,
9	  type-incompatible comparisons
10	
11	The accepted grammar (keywords case-insensitive)::
12	
13	    query       := SELECT ('*' | ident (',' ident)*)
14	                   FROM ident [WHERE expr]
15	    expr       := or_expr
16	    or_expr     := and_expr (OR and_expr)*
17	    and_expr    := cmp_expr (AND cmp_expr)*
18	    cmp_expr    := not_factor (cmp_op not_factor)?
19	    not_factor  := NOT not_factor | postfix
20	    postfix     := atom (IS [NOT] NULL)?
21	    atom        := '(' expr ')' | operand
22	    operand     := ident | literal
23	    literal     := TRUE | FALSE | [+-]? int64 | [+-]? finite float64
24	                   | single-quoted utf8
25	
26	Operator precedence (highest first) is NOT, comparison, AND, OR; IS [NOT]
27	NULL is a postfix of its atom.  Comparison operands must be column
28	references or literals.  WHERE follows SQL three-valued logic: a normal
29	comparison against NULL yields UNKNOWN, UNKNOWN propagates through the
30	logical operators, and only TRUE rows are returned.
31	"""
32	
33	from __future__ import annotations
34	
35	import math
36	import re
37	from dataclasses import dataclass
38	from typing import Any
39	
40	from .format import Schema, Table, read_file
41	
42	__all__ = [
43	    "QuerySyntaxError",
44	    "QueryValidationError",
45	    "query_file",
46	]
47	
48	_KEYWORDS = frozenset(
49	    ("select", "from", "where", "not", "and", "or", "is", "null", "true", "false")
50	)
51	
52	
53	class QuerySyntaxError(Exception):
54	    """Raised when a query is lexically or grammatically invalid."""
55	
56	
57	class QueryValidationError(Exception):
58	    """Raised when a syntactically valid query is incompatible with the schema."""
59	
60	
61	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
62	# Tokeniser
63	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
64	
65	
66	@dataclass(frozen=True)
67	class _Token:
68	    kind: str  # one of: keyword, ident, number, string, op, star, eof
69	    value: Any
70	    text: str
71	
72	
73	_NUMBER_RE = re.compile(
74	    r"""
75	    \d+(?:\.\d*)?(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?   # 1, 1., 1.5, 1e3, 1.5e-2
76	    | \.\d+(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?         # .5
77	    """,
78	    re.VERBOSE,
79	)
80	# Bare identifiers: Unicode letters/underscore first, then word characters.
81	_IDENT_RE = re.compile(r"[^\W\d]\w*", re.UNICODE)
82	
83	
84	def _tokenize(sql: str) -> list[_Token]:
85	    if not isinstance(sql, str):
86	        raise QuerySyntaxError("SQL statement must be a string")
87	    tokens: list[_Token] = []
88	    i = 0
89	    n = len(sql)
90	    while i < n:
91	        ch = sql[i]
92	        if ch.isspace():
93	            i += 1
94	            continue
95	        if ch == "*":
96	            tokens.append(_Token("star", None, ch))
97	            i += 1
98	            continue
99	        if ch in ",()+-":
100	            tokens.append(_Token("op", ch, ch))
101	            i += 1
102	            continue
103	        if ch in "=<>!":
104	            if ch == "!" and i + 1 < n and sql[i + 1] == "=":
105	                tokens.append(_Token("op", "!=", "!="))
106	                i += 2
107	                continue
108	            if ch in "<>" and i + 1 < n and sql[i + 1] == "=":
109	                op = ch + "="
110	                tokens.append(_Token("op", op, op))
111	                i += 2
112	                continue
113	            if ch in "=<>":
114	                tokens.append(_Token("op", ch, ch))
115	                i += 1
116	                continue
117	            raise QuerySyntaxError(f"unexpected character '!' at position {i}")
118	        if ch == "'":
119	            value, new_i = _tokenize_string(sql, i)
120	            tokens.append(_Token("string", value, sql[i:new_i]))
121	            i = new_i
122	            continue
123	        if ch == '"':
124	            value, new_i = _tokenize_quoted_ident(sql, i)
125	            tokens.append(_token_from_word(value, quoted=True))
126	            i = new_i
127	            continue
128	        if ch.isdigit() or ch == ".":
129	            match = _NUMBER_RE.match(sql, i)
130	            if match:
131	                text = match.group(0)
132	                if text == ".":
133	                    raise QuerySyntaxError(f"unexpected character '.' at position {i}")
134	                tokens.append(_Token("number", _parse_number(text), text))
135	                i = match.end()
136	                continue
137	        match = _IDENT_RE.match(sql, i)
138	        if match:
139	            text = match.group(0)
140	            tokens.append(_token_from_word(text, quoted=False))
141	            i = match.end()
142	            continue
143	        raise QuerySyntaxError(f"unexpected character {ch!r} at position {i}")
144	    tokens.append(_Token("eof", None, ""))
145	    return tokens
146	
147	
148	def _token_from_word(word: str, *, quoted: bool) -> _Token:
149	    lowered = word.lower()
150	    if not quoted and lowered in _KEYWORDS:
151	        if lowered == "true":
152	            return _Token("number", True, word)
153	        if lowered == "false":
154	            return _Token("number", False, word)
155	        return _Token("keyword", lowered, word)
156	    return _Token("qident" if quoted else "ident", word, word)
157	
158	
159	def _tokenize_string(sql: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, int]:
160	    parts: list[str] = []
161	    i = start + 1
162	    n = len(sql)
163	    while True:
164	        j = sql.find("'", i)
165	        if j == -1:
166	            raise QuerySyntaxError("unterminated string literal")
167	        parts.append(sql[i:j])
168	        if j + 1 < n and sql[j + 1] == "'":
169	            parts.append("'")
170	            i = j + 2
171	            continue
172	        value = "".join(parts)
173	        try:
174	            value.encode("utf-8")
175	        except UnicodeEncodeError:
176	            raise QuerySyntaxError("string literal is not valid UTF-8") from None
177	        return value, j + 1
178	
179	
180	def _tokenize_quoted_ident(sql: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, int]:
181	    parts: list[str] = []
182	    i = start + 1
183	    n = len(sql)
184	    while True:
185	        j = sql.find('"', i)
186	        if j == -1:
187	            raise QuerySyntaxError("unterminated quoted identifier")
188	        parts.append(sql[i:j])
189	        if j + 1 < n and sql[j + 1] == '"':
190	            parts.append('"')
191	            i = j + 2
192	            continue
193	        value = "".join(parts)
194	        if not value:
195	            raise QuerySyntaxError("quoted identifier must not be empty")
196	        return value, j + 1
197	
198	
199	def _parse_number(text: str) -> int | float:
200	    try:
201	        if any(ch in text for ch in ".eE"):
202	            value: int | float = float(text)
203	        else:
204	            value = int(text, 10)
205	    except ValueError:
206	        raise QuerySyntaxError(f"invalid numeric literal {text!r}") from None
207	    if isinstance(value, int):
208	        # The magnitude 2**63 is accepted unsigned; the signed range check
209	        # happens after the optional leading sign is applied.
210	        if not (0 <= value <= 2**63):
211	            raise QuerySyntaxError(f"integer literal {text} is outside the int64 range")
212	        return value
213	    if not math.isfinite(value):
214	        raise QuerySyntaxError(f"float literal {text} must be finite")
215	    return value
216	
217	
218	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
219	# Parsed expression tree
220	#
221	# Node tuples:
222	#   ("literal", python_value, type_name)
223	#   ("column", name, index, type_name, nullable)
224	#   ("cmp", op, left_node, right_node)
225	#   ("isnull", operand, negate)
226	#   ("not", operand)
227	#   ("and"|"or", left, right)
228	# Predicate nodes are boolean-typed (three-valued at evaluation time).
229	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
230	
231	
232	@dataclass
233	class _Select:
234	    columns: tuple[str, ...] | None  # None means '*'
235	    table: str
236	    table_quoted: bool
237	    where: tuple | None
238	
239	
240	class _Parser:
241	    _CMP_OPS = frozenset(("=", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">="))
242	
243	    def __init__(self, tokens: list[_Token]):
244	        self.tokens = tokens
245	        self.pos = 0
246	
247	    def parse(self) -> _Select:
248	        select = self._parse_select()
249	        if self._peek().kind != "eof":
250	            tok = self._peek()
251	            raise QuerySyntaxError(f"unexpected trailing input {tok.text!r}")
252	        return select
253	
254	    def _parse_select(self) -> _Select:
255	        self._expect_keyword("select")
256	        if self._accept("star"):
257	            columns: tuple[str, ...] | None = None
258	        else:
259	            columns = tuple(self._parse_projection())
260	        self._expect_keyword("from")
261	        table_tok = self._expect_table_name()
262	        where = None
263	        if self._accept_keyword("where"):
264	            where = self._parse_or()
265	        return _Select(
266	            columns=columns,
267	            table=table_tok.value,
268	            table_quoted=table_tok.kind == "qident",
269	            where=where,
270	        )
271	
272	    def _parse_projection(self) -> list[str]:
273	        names = [self._expect_identifier_name()]
274	        while self._accept_op(","):
275	            names.append(self._expect_identifier_name())
276	        return names
277	
278	    def _expect_table_name(self) -> _Token:
279	        tok = self._peek()
280	        if tok.kind in ("ident", "qident"):
281	            return self._next()
282	        raise QuerySyntaxError(f"expected table name, got {tok.text!r}")
283	
284	    def _expect_identifier_name(self) -> str:
285	        tok = self._peek()
286	        if tok.kind in ("ident", "qident"):
287	            self._next()
288	            return tok.value
289	        raise QuerySyntaxError(f"expected identifier, got {tok.text!r}")
290	
291	    # WHERE expression grammar ------------------------------------------------
292	
293	    def _parse_or(self) -> tuple:
294	        node = self._parse_and()
295	        while self._accept_keyword("or"):
296	            node = ("or", node, self._parse_and())
297	        return node
298	
299	    def _parse_and(self) -> tuple:
300	        node = self._parse_comparison()
301	        while self._accept_keyword("and"):
302	            node = ("and", node, self._parse_comparison())
303	        return node
304	
305	    def _parse_comparison(self) -> tuple:
306	        left = self._parse_not_factor()
307	        tok = self._peek()
308	        if tok.kind == "op" and tok.value in self._CMP_OPS:
309	            self._next()
310	            right = self._parse_not_factor()
311	            return ("cmp", tok.value, left, right)
312	        return left
313	
314	    def _parse_not_factor(self) -> tuple:
315	        if self._accept_keyword("not"):
316	            return ("not", self._parse_not_factor())
317	        return self._parse_postfix()
318	
319	    def _parse_postfix(self) -> tuple:
320	        node = self._parse_atom()
321	        if self._accept_keyword("is"):
322	            negate = self._accept_keyword("not")
323	            self._expect_keyword("null")
324	            node = ("isnull", node, negate)
325	        return node
326	
327	    def _parse_atom(self) -> tuple:
328	        if self._accept_op("("):
329	            node = self._parse_or()
330	            self._expect_op(")")
331	            return node
332	        return self._parse_operand()
333	
334	    def _parse_operand(self) -> tuple:
335	        sign = 1
336	        tok = self._peek()
337	        if tok.kind == "op" and tok.value in ("+", "-"):
338	            if tok.value == "-":
339	                sign = -1
340	            self._next()
341	            tok = self._peek()
342	            if tok.kind != "number" or isinstance(tok.value, bool):
343	                raise QuerySyntaxError("sign must be followed by a numeric literal")
344	        if tok.kind == "number":
345	            self._next()
346	            value = tok.value
347	            if isinstance(value, bool):
348	                if sign == -1:
349	                    raise QuerySyntaxError("boolean literal cannot be negated")
350	                return ("literal", value, "bool")
351	            if isinstance(value, int):
352	                value *= sign
353	                if not (-(2**63) <= value <= 2**63 - 1):
354	                    raise QuerySyntaxError("integer literal is outside the int64 range")
355	            else:
356	                value = math.copysign(value, sign) if sign == -1 else value
357	                if not math.isfinite(value):
358	                    raise QuerySyntaxError("float literal must be finite")
359	            type_name = "int64" if isinstance(value, int) else "float64"
360	            return ("literal", value, type_name)
361	        if tok.kind == "string":
362	            if sign == -1:
363	                raise QuerySyntaxError("string literal cannot be negated")
364	            self._next()
365	            return ("literal", tok.value, "utf8")
366	        if tok.kind in ("ident", "qident"):
367	            if sign == -1:
368	                raise QuerySyntaxError("column reference cannot be negated")
369	            self._next()
370	            return ("column", tok.value, None, None, None)
371	        if tok.kind == "keyword":
372	            raise QuerySyntaxError(f"unexpected keyword {tok.text.upper()!r} in expression")
373	        raise QuerySyntaxError(f"unexpected token {tok.text!r} in expression")
374	
375	    # Token helpers -----------------------------------------------------------
376	
377	    def _peek(self) -> _Token:
378	        return self.tokens[self.pos]
379	
380	    def _next(self) -> _Token:
381	        tok = self.tokens[self.pos]
382	        self.pos += 1
383	        return tok
384	
385	    def _accept(self, kind: str) -> bool:
386	        if self._peek().kind == kind:
387	            self.pos += 1
388	            return True
389	        return False
390	
391	    def _accept_op(self, value: str) -> bool:
392	        tok = self._peek()
393	        if tok.kind == "op" and tok.value == value:
394	            self.pos += 1
395	            return True
396	        return False
397	
398	    def _accept_keyword(self, value: str) -> bool:
399	        tok = self._peek()
400	        if tok.kind == "keyword" and tok.value == value:
401	            self.pos += 1
402	            return True
403	        return False
404	
405	    def _expect_keyword(self, value: str) -> _Token:
406	        tok = self._peek()
407	        if tok.kind != "keyword" or tok.value != value:
408	            raise QuerySyntaxError(f"expected {value.upper()}, got {tok.text!r}")
409	        return self._next()
410	
411	    def _expect_op(self, value: str) -> _Token:
412	        tok = self._peek()
413	        if tok.kind != "op" or tok.value != value:
414	            raise QuerySyntaxError(f"expected {value!r}, got {tok.text!r}")
415	        return self._next()
416	
417	
418	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
419	# Binding: schema resolution, projection checks and type compatibility
420	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
421	
422	
423	def _bind_select(select: _Select, schema: Schema) -> tuple[tuple[int, ...], tuple | None]:
424	    table_matches = (
425	        select.table == "input"
426	        if select.table_quoted
427	        else select.table.lower() == "input"
428	    )
429	    if not table_matches:
430	        raise QueryValidationError(f"unknown table {select.table!r}; only 'input' is supported")
431	    if select.columns is None:
432	        indices = tuple(range(len(schema.columns)))
433	    else:
434	        seen: set[str] = set()
435	        indices_list: list[int] = []
436	        for name in select.columns:
437	            if name in seen:
438	                raise QueryValidationError(f"duplicate column in projection: {name!r}")
439	            seen.add(name)
440	            try:
441	                indices_list.append(schema.index(name))
442	            except KeyError:
443	                raise QueryValidationError(f"unknown column: {name!r}") from None
444	        indices = tuple(indices_list)
445	    where = _bind_expr(select.where, schema) if select.where is not None else None
446	    if where is not None and where[0] in ("literal", "column"):
447	        type_name = _operand_type(where)
448	        if type_name != "bool":
449	            raise QueryValidationError(
450	                f"WHERE clause must be boolean, got {type_name}"
451	            )
452	    return indices, where
453	
454	
455	def _bind_expr(node: tuple, schema: Schema) -> tuple:
456	    tag = node[0]
457	    if tag == "literal":
458	        return node
459	    if tag == "column":
460	        name = node[1]
461	        try:
462	            index = schema.index(name)
463	        except KeyError:
464	            raise QueryValidationError(f"unknown column: {name!r}") from None
465	        col = schema.columns[index]
466	        return ("column", name, index, col.type, col.nullable)
467	    if tag == "not":
468	        operand = _bind_expr(node[1], schema)
469	        _require_boolean(operand, "NOT")
470	        return ("not", operand)
471	    if tag in ("and", "or"):
472	        left = _bind_expr(node[1], schema)
473	        right = _bind_expr(node[2], schema)
474	        _require_boolean(left, tag.upper())
475	        _require_boolean(right, tag.upper())
476	        return (tag, left, right)
477	    if tag == "isnull":
478	        operand = _bind_expr(node[1], schema)
479	        if operand[0] not in ("literal", "column"):
480	            raise QuerySyntaxError(
481	                "IS NULL operand must be a column reference or a literal"
482	            )
483	        return ("isnull", operand, node[2])
484	    if tag == "cmp":
485	        op = node[1]
486	        left = _bind_expr(node[2], schema)
487	        right = _bind_expr(node[3], schema)
488	        if left[0] not in ("literal", "column") or right[0] not in ("literal", "column"):
489	            raise QuerySyntaxError("comparison operands must be column references or literals")
490	        left_t = _operand_type(left)
491	        right_t = _operand_type(right)
492	        if "bool" in (left_t, right_t):
493	            if left_t != "bool" or right_t != "bool":
494	                raise QueryValidationError(
495	                    f"bool can only be compared to bool, got {left_t} and {right_t}"
496	                )
497	            if op not in ("=", "!="):
498	                raise QueryValidationError(f"bool only supports = and !=, not {op!r}")
499	        elif "utf8" in (left_t, right_t):
500	            if left_t != "utf8" or right_t != "utf8":
501	                raise QueryValidationError(
502	                    f"utf8 can only be compared to utf8, got {left_t} and {right_t}"
503	                )
504	        elif not {left_t, right_t} <= {"int64", "float64"}:
505	            raise QueryValidationError(
506	                f"cannot compare values of type {left_t} and {right_t}"
507	            )
508	        return ("cmp", op, left, right)
509	    raise QuerySyntaxError(f"unsupported expression: {tag}")  # pragma: no cover - defensive
510	
511	
512	def _operand_type(node: tuple) -> str:
513	    return node[2] if node[0] == "literal" else node[3]
514	
515	
516	def _require_boolean(node: tuple, context: str) -> None:
517	    if node[0] in ("cmp", "isnull", "not", "and", "or"):
518	        return
519	    type_name = node[2] if node[0] == "literal" else node[3]
520	    if type_name != "bool":
521	        raise QueryValidationError(f"{context} requires a boolean operand, got {type_name}")
522	
523	
524	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
525	# Three-valued-logic evaluation
526	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
527	
528	
529	def _eval(node: tuple, row: tuple) -> bool | None:
530	    tag = node[0]
531	    if tag == "literal":
532	        return node[1]
533	    if tag == "column":
534	        return row[node[2]]
535	    if tag == "isnull":
536	        value = _eval(node[1], row)
537	        result = value is None
538	        return (not result) if node[2] else result
539	    if tag == "not":
540	        value = _eval(node[1], row)
541	        return None if value is None else (not value)
542	    if tag in ("and", "or"):
543	        # Short-circuit SQL semantics; UNKNOWN propagates only when needed.
544	        if tag == "and":
545	            left = _eval(node[1], row)
546	            if left is False:
547	                return False
548	            right = _eval(node[2], row)
549	            if right is False:
550	                return False
551	            if left is None or right is None:
552	                return None
553	            return True
554	        left = _eval(node[1], row)
555	        if left is True:
556	            return True
557	        right = _eval(node[2], row)
558	        if right is True:
559	            return True
560	        if left is None or right is None:
561	            return None
562	        return False
563	    if tag == "cmp":
564	        left = _eval(node[2], row)
565	        right = _eval(node[3], row)
566	        if left is None or right is None:
567	            return None
568	        op = node[1]
569	        if op == "=":
570	            result = left == right
571	        elif op == "!=":
572	            result = left != right
573	        elif op == "<":
574	            result = left < right
575	        elif op == "<=":
576	            result = left <= right
577	        elif op == ">":
578	            result = left > right
579	        else:  # ">="
580	            result = left >= right
581	        return bool(result)
582	    raise QuerySyntaxError(f"unsupported expression: {tag}")  # pragma: no cover
583	
584	
585	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
586	# Public entry points
587	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
588	
589	
590	def query_file(path: Any, sql: str) -> Table:
591	    """Run ``sql`` against the single columnar file ``path``.
592	
593	    Returns a :class:`~columnar_analytics.format.Table` with columns in
594	    projection order and rows in the file's original order.  The statement is
595	    parsed before the file is touched, so purely grammatical errors surface as
596	    :class:`QuerySyntaxError` regardless of whether ``path`` exists.  Unknown
597	    columns, the wrong table name or type-incompatible predicates raise
598	    :class:`QueryValidationError`; malformed files raise
599	    :class:`~columnar_analytics.format.ColumnarFormatError`; other I/O
600	    failures propagate as :class:`OSError`.
601	    """
602	    tokens = _tokenize(sql)
603	    select = _Parser(tokens).parse()
604	    table = read_file(path)
605	    return _run_query(table, select)
606	
607	
608	def query_table(table: Table, sql: str) -> Table:
609	    """Apply ``sql`` (``FROM input``) to an in-memory table."""
610	    tokens = _tokenize(sql)
611	    select = _Parser(tokens).parse()
612	    return _run_query(table, select)
613	
614	
615	def _run_query(table: Table, select: _Select) -> Table:
616	    indices, where = _bind_select(select, table.schema)
617	
618	    source_columns = table._columns
619	    row_count = table.row_count
620	    if where is None:
621	        out_columns = [source_columns[index] for index in indices]
622	    else:
623	        selected = [
624	            i
625	            for i in range(row_count)
626	            if _eval(where, tuple(col[i] for col in source_columns)) is True
627	        ]
628	        out_columns = [
629	            tuple(source_columns[index][i] for i in selected) for index in indices
630	        ]
631	
632	    out_schema = Schema([table.schema.columns[i] for i in indices])
633	    return Table._from_storage(out_schema, out_columns)
634

1	"""Self-describing columnar file format.
2	
3	Public API:
4	
5	* :class:`ColumnSchema` / :class:`Schema` / :class:`Table` -- in-memory model
6	* :func:`write_file` -- deterministic, atomic write
7	* :func:`read_file` -- strict, validating read with optional projection
8	* :func:`inspect_file` -- metadata-only read
9	* :class:`ColumnarFormatError` -- raised for every malformed-file condition
10	
11	File layout (little-endian)::
12	
13	    b"CAEF"            magic
14	    uint8              format version
15	    uint32             header byte length
16	    <header bytes>     UTF-8 JSON, schema + per-column stats/chunk pointers
17	    <data section>     raw concatenated column payloads, or zlib of the same
18	    uint32             CRC-32 of every preceding byte
19	    b"END1"            end marker
20	
21	The same schema, values and options always produce identical bytes: the JSON
22	header uses a fixed key order and compact separators, there are no timestamps,
23	and zlib is invoked with a fixed level.
24	"""
25	
26	from __future__ import annotations
27	
28	import json
29	import os
30	import struct
31	import tempfile
32	import zlib
33	from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
34	from dataclasses import dataclass
35	from typing import Any
36	
37	__all__ = [
38	    "FORMAT_VERSION",
39	    "ColumnarFormatError",
40	    "ColumnSchema",
41	    "Schema",
42	    "Table",
43	    "write_file",
44	    "read_file",
45	    "inspect_file",
46	]
47	
48	FORMAT_VERSION = 1
49	
50	_MAGIC = b"CAEF"
51	_FOOTER_MARKER = b"END1"
52	_TYPE_NAMES = ("bool", "int64", "float64", "utf8")
53	_ENCODING_NAMES = ("plain", "dictionary")
54	_COMPRESSION_NAMES = ("none", "zlib")
55	_HEADER_KEYS = frozenset(
56	    ("compression", "row_count", "data_length", "data_crc32", "uncompressed_length", "columns")
57	)
58	_COLUMN_KEYS = frozenset(
59	    ("name", "type", "nullable", "encoding", "offset", "length", "crc32",
60	     "null_count", "min", "max")
61	)
62	_PREFIX_LEN = 9  # magic(4) + version(1) + header length uint32
63	_FOOTER_LEN = 8  # crc32 uint32 + marker
64	_MAX_HEADER_BYTES = 256 * 1024 * 1024
65	
66	
67	class ColumnarFormatError(Exception):
68	    """Raised when a columnar file is structurally invalid or unsupported."""
69	
70	
71	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
72	# In-memory model
73	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
74	
75	
76	@dataclass(frozen=True)
77	class ColumnSchema:
78	    """One column: a non-empty unique Unicode ``name``, a type and nullability."""
79	
80	    name: str
81	    type: str
82	    nullable: bool = False
83	
84	    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
85	        if not isinstance(self.name, str) or not self.name:
86	            raise ValueError("column name must be a non-empty string")
87	        try:
88	            self.name.encode("utf-8")
89	        except UnicodeEncodeError:
90	            raise ValueError("column name must contain valid Unicode scalars") from None
91	        if self.type not in _TYPE_NAMES:
92	            raise ValueError(f"unsupported column type: {self.type!r}")
93	        if not isinstance(self.nullable, bool):
94	            raise ValueError("nullable must be a bool")
95	
96	
97	@dataclass(frozen=True)
98	class Schema:
99	    """An ordered, non-empty collection of :class:`ColumnSchema`."""
100	
101	    columns: tuple[ColumnSchema, ...]
102	
103	    def __init__(self, columns: Sequence[ColumnSchema]):
104	        cols = tuple(columns)
105	        if not cols:
106	            raise ValueError("schema must contain at least one column")
107	        for col in cols:
108	            if not isinstance(col, ColumnSchema):
109	                raise ValueError("schema entries must be ColumnSchema instances")
110	        seen: set[str] = set()
111	        for col in cols:
112	            if col.name in seen:
113	                raise ValueError(f"duplicate column name: {col.name!r}")
114	            seen.add(col.name)
115	        object.__setattr__(self, "columns", cols)
116	
117	    @property
118	    def names(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
119	        return tuple(col.name for col in self.columns)
120	
121	    def index(self, name: str) -> int:
122	        for i, col in enumerate(self.columns):
123	            if col.name == name:
124	                return i
125	        raise KeyError(name)
126	
127	
128	class Table:
129	    """A schema together with equal-length, column-oriented Python lists."""
130	
131	    def __init__(self, schema: Schema, columns: Mapping[str, Sequence] | Sequence[Sequence]):
132	        if not isinstance(schema, Schema):
133	            raise TypeError("schema must be a Schema instance")
134	        aligned = _align_columns(schema, columns)
135	        row_count = _validate_columns(schema, aligned)
136	        self.schema = schema
137	        self._row_count = row_count
138	        self._columns = tuple(tuple(col) for col in aligned)
139	
140	    @classmethod
141	    def _from_storage(cls, schema: Schema, columns: Sequence[Sequence]) -> "Table":
142	        """Build without re-validating (used by the decoder)."""
143	        obj = cls.__new__(cls)
144	        obj.schema = schema
145	        obj._row_count = len(columns[0]) if columns else 0
146	        obj._columns = tuple(tuple(col) for col in columns)
147	        return obj
148	
149	    @property
150	    def row_count(self) -> int:
151	        return self._row_count
152	
153	    @property
154	    def column_names(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
155	        return self.schema.names
156	
157	    def column(self, name: str) -> list:
158	        """Return a fresh list of the named column's values."""
159	        return list(self._columns[self.schema.index(name)])
160	
161	    @property
162	    def columns(self) -> dict[str, list]:
163	        """Column name to value list, in schema order."""
164	        return {name: list(self._columns[i]) for i, name in enumerate(self.schema.names)}
165	
166	    def project(self, names: Sequence[str]) -> "Table":
167	        """Return a table restricted to ``names``, in the requested order.
168	
169	        Unknown names raise :class:`KeyError`; repeated names raise
170	        :class:`ValueError`.
171	        """
172	        if isinstance(names, str):
173	            raise ValueError("project names must be a sequence of strings, not a single string")
174	        requested = tuple(names)
175	        if len(set(requested)) != len(requested):
176	            raise ValueError("projection contains duplicate column names")
177	        indices = []
178	        for name in requested:
179	            indices.append(self.schema.index(name))  # KeyError on unknown name
180	        sub_schema = Schema([self.schema.columns[i] for i in indices])
181	        sub_cols = [self._columns[i] for i in indices]
182	        return Table._from_storage(sub_schema, sub_cols)
183	
184	
185	def _align_columns(
186	    schema: Schema, columns: Mapping[str, Sequence] | Sequence[Sequence]
187	) -> list[Sequence]:
188	    if isinstance(columns, Mapping):
189	        missing = [name for name in schema.names if name not in columns]
190	        if missing:
191	            raise ValueError(f"missing column(s): {', '.join(missing)!r}")
192	        extra = [name for name in columns if name not in set(schema.names)]
193	        if extra:
194	            raise ValueError(f"unexpected column(s): {', '.join(map(str, extra))!r}")
195	        return [columns[name] for name in schema.names]
196	    if isinstance(columns, Sequence) and not isinstance(columns, (str, bytes)):
197	        if len(columns) != len(schema.columns):
198	            raise ValueError(
199	                f"expected {len(schema.columns)} columns, got {len(columns)}"
200	            )
201	        return list(columns)
202	    raise TypeError("columns must be a mapping or a sequence aligned to the schema")
203	
204	
205	def _validate_columns(schema: Schema, columns: Sequence[Sequence]) -> int:
206	    """Check shape, nullability, per-value Python types and float finiteness."""
207	    row_count: int | None = None
208	    for col, raw in zip(schema.columns, columns):
209	        try:
210	            values = list(raw)
211	        except TypeError:
212	            raise ValueError(f"column {col.name!r} is not a sequence") from None
213	        if row_count is None:
214	            row_count = len(values)
215	        elif len(values) != row_count:
216	            raise ValueError(
217	                f"column {col.name!r} has {len(values)} rows, expected {row_count}"
218	            )
219	        for position, value in enumerate(values):
220	            where = f"column {col.name!r} row {position}"
221	            if value is None:
222	                if not col.nullable:
223	                    raise ValueError(f"{where}: NULL in non-nullable column")
224	                continue
225	            if col.type == "bool":
226	                if not isinstance(value, bool):
227	                    raise ValueError(f"{where}: expected bool, got {type(value).__name__}")
228	            elif col.type == "int64":
229	                if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int):
230	                    raise ValueError(f"{where}: expected int64, got {type(value).__name__}")
231	                if not (-(2**63) <= value <= 2**63 - 1):
232	                    raise ValueError(f"{where}: value outside int64 range")
233	            elif col.type == "float64":
234	                if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, float):
235	                    raise ValueError(f"{where}: expected float64, got {type(value).__name__}")
236	                if value != value or value in (float("inf"), float("-inf")):
237	                    raise ValueError(f"{where}: float64 must be finite (no NaN or infinity)")
238	            elif col.type == "utf8":
239	                if not isinstance(value, str):
240	                    raise ValueError(f"{where}: expected utf8 string, got {type(value).__name__}")
241	                try:
242	                    value.encode("utf-8")
243	                except UnicodeEncodeError:
244	                    raise ValueError(f"{where}: string is not valid UTF-8 Unicode") from None
245	    assert row_count is not None
246	    return row_count
247	
248	
249	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
250	# Encoding
251	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
252	
253	
254	def _pack_bits(flags: Sequence[bool]) -> bytes:
255	    out = bytearray((len(flags) + 7) // 8)
256	    for i, flag in enumerate(flags):
257	        if flag:
258	            out[i >> 3] |= 1 << (i & 7)
259	    return bytes(out)
260	
261	
262	def _check_padding(bits: bytes, count: int, what: str) -> None:
263	    if count % 8:
264	        unused = bits[-1] >> (count % 8)
265	        if unused:
266	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"non-zero padding bits in {what}")
267	
268	
269	def _encode_payload(
270	    col: ColumnSchema, values: Sequence, use_dictionary: bool
271	) -> tuple[bytes, int, Any, Any]:
272	    n = len(values)
273	    null_count = 0
274	    minimum: Any = None
275	    maximum: Any = None
276	    validity = bytearray((n + 7) // 8) if col.nullable else None
277	
278	    if col.type == "bool":
279	        flags: list[bool] = []
280	        for i, value in enumerate(values):
281	            if value is None:
282	                flags.append(False)
283	                null_count += 1
284	                continue
285	            if validity is not None:
286	                validity[i >> 3] |= 1 << (i & 7)
287	            flags.append(value)
288	            if minimum is None or value < minimum:
289	                minimum = value
290	            if maximum is None or value > maximum:
291	                maximum = value
292	        body = _pack_bits(flags)
293	    elif col.type == "int64":
294	        buf = bytearray()
295	        for i, value in enumerate(values):
296	            if value is None:
297	                buf.extend(b"\x00" * 8)
298	                null_count += 1
299	                continue
300	            if validity is not None:
301	                validity[i >> 3] |= 1 << (i & 7)
302	            buf.extend(struct.pack("<q", value))
303	            if minimum is None or value < minimum:
304	                minimum = value
305	            if maximum is None or value > maximum:
306	                maximum = value
307	        body = bytes(buf)
308	    elif col.type == "float64":
309	        buf = bytearray()
310	        for i, value in enumerate(values):
311	            if value is None:
312	                buf.extend(b"\x00" * 8)
313	                null_count += 1
314	                continue
315	            if validity is not None:
316	                validity[i >> 3] |= 1 << (i & 7)
317	            buf.extend(struct.pack("<d", value))
318	            if minimum is None or value < minimum:
319	                minimum = value
320	            if maximum is None or value > maximum:
321	                maximum = value
322	        body = bytes(buf)
323	    else:  # utf8
324	        if use_dictionary:
325	            dictionary: list[str] = []
326	            dictionary_index: dict[str, int] = {}
327	            indices = bytearray()
328	            for i, value in enumerate(values):
329	                if value is None:
330	                    indices.extend(struct.pack("<i", -1))
331	                    null_count += 1
332	                    continue
333	                if validity is not None:
334	                    validity[i >> 3] |= 1 << (i & 7)
335	                idx = dictionary_index.get(value)
336	                if idx is None:
337	                    # Dictionary ids follow first-occurrence order.
338	                    idx = len(dictionary)
339	                    dictionary_index[value] = idx
340	                    dictionary.append(value)
341	                indices.extend(struct.pack("<i", idx))
342	                if minimum is None or value < minimum:
343	                    minimum = value
344	                if maximum is None or value > maximum:
345	                    maximum = value
346	            body = (
347	                struct.pack("<I", len(dictionary))
348	                + _encode_utf8_strings(dictionary)
349	                + bytes(indices)
350	            )
351	        else:
352	            ordered: list[str] = []
353	            for i, value in enumerate(values):
354	                if value is None:
355	                    ordered.append("")
356	                    null_count += 1
357	                    continue
358	                if validity is not None:
359	                    validity[i >> 3] |= 1 << (i & 7)
360	                ordered.append(value)
361	                if minimum is None or value < minimum:
362	                    minimum = value
363	                if maximum is None or value > maximum:
364	                    maximum = value
365	            body = _encode_utf8_strings(ordered)
366	
367	    payload = (bytes(validity) if validity is not None else b"") + body
368	    return payload, null_count, minimum, maximum
369	
370	
371	def _encode_utf8_strings(strings: Sequence[str]) -> bytes:
372	    offsets = bytearray()
373	    blob = bytearray()
374	    cursor = 0
375	    offsets.extend(struct.pack("<I", 0))
376	    for value in strings:
377	        raw = value.encode("utf-8")
378	        cursor += len(raw)
379	        blob.extend(raw)
380	        offsets.extend(struct.pack("<I", cursor))
381	    return bytes(offsets) + bytes(blob)

384	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
385	# Decoding
386	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
387	
388	
389	def _decode_column(
390	    col: ColumnSchema, encoding: str, row_count: int, payload: bytes
391	) -> list:
392	    cursor = 0
393	    validity: bytes | None = None
394	    if col.nullable:
395	        size = (row_count + 7) // 8
396	        if len(payload) < cursor + size:
397	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"truncated validity bitmap for {col.name!r}")
398	        validity = payload[cursor : cursor + size]
399	        _check_padding(validity, row_count, f"validity bitmap of {col.name!r}")
400	        cursor += size
401	    body = payload[cursor:]
402	
403	    if col.type == "bool":
404	        size = (row_count + 7) // 8
405	        if len(body) != size:
406	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"bad bool payload length for {col.name!r}")
407	        _check_padding(body, row_count, f"bool payload of {col.name!r}")
408	        values = [
409	            bool((body[i >> 3] >> (i & 7)) & 1) for i in range(row_count)
410	        ]
411	    elif col.type == "int64":
412	        if len(body) != 8 * row_count:
413	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"bad int64 payload length for {col.name!r}")
414	        values = list(struct.unpack(f"<{row_count}q", body)) if row_count else []
415	    elif col.type == "float64":
416	        if len(body) != 8 * row_count:
417	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"bad float64 payload length for {col.name!r}")
418	        values = list(struct.unpack(f"<{row_count}d", body)) if row_count else []
419	        for i, value in enumerate(values):
420	            if value != value or value in (float("inf"), float("-inf")):
421	                raise ColumnarFormatError(
422	                    f"non-finite float64 stored in {col.name!r} row {i}"
423	                )
424	    elif encoding == "dictionary":
425	        values = _decode_dict_utf8(col, row_count, body, validity)
426	    else:
427	        values = _decode_plain_utf8(col, row_count, body)
428	
429	    if validity is not None:
430	        for i in range(row_count):
431	            if not ((validity[i >> 3] >> (i & 7)) & 1):
432	                values[i] = None
433	    return values
434	
435	
436	def _decode_utf8_blob(col: ColumnSchema, body: bytes, count: int, *, what: str) -> list[str]:
437	    offset_bytes = 4 * (count + 1)
438	    if len(body) < offset_bytes:
439	        raise ColumnarFormatError(f"truncated {what} offsets for {col.name!r}")
440	    offsets = struct.unpack(f"<{count + 1}I", body[:offset_bytes])
441	    blob = body[offset_bytes:]
442	    if offsets[0] != 0:
443	        raise ColumnarFormatError(f"{what} offsets must start at 0 for {col.name!r}")
444	    for prev, nxt in zip(offsets, offsets[1:]):
445	        if nxt < prev:
446	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"non-monotonic {what} offsets for {col.name!r}")
447	    if offsets[-1] != len(blob):
448	        raise ColumnarFormatError(f"{what} byte length mismatch for {col.name!r}")
449	    strings = []
450	    for i in range(count):
451	        raw = blob[offsets[i] : offsets[i + 1]]
452	        try:
453	            strings.append(raw.decode("utf-8"))
454	        except UnicodeDecodeError:
455	            raise ColumnarFormatError(
456	                f"invalid UTF-8 in {what} entry {i} of {col.name!r}"
457	            ) from None
458	    return strings
459	
460	
461	def _decode_plain_utf8(col: ColumnSchema, row_count: int, body: bytes) -> list[str]:
462	    return _decode_utf8_blob(col, body, row_count, what="utf8")
463	
464	
465	def _decode_dict_utf8(
466	    col: ColumnSchema, row_count: int, body: bytes, validity: bytes | None
467	) -> list[str]:
468	    if len(body) < 4:
469	        raise ColumnarFormatError(f"truncated dictionary header for {col.name!r}")
470	    (dict_size,) = struct.unpack("<I", body[:4])
471	    rest = body[4:]
472	    offset_bytes = 4 * (dict_size + 1)
473	    # Split dictionary section from the trailing row indices.
474	    if len(rest) < offset_bytes:
475	        raise ColumnarFormatError(f"truncated dictionary offsets for {col.name!r}")
476	    tentative_offsets = struct.unpack(f"<{dict_size + 1}I", rest[:offset_bytes])
477	    dict_section_len = offset_bytes + tentative_offsets[-1]
478	    if dict_section_len > len(rest) - 4 * row_count:
479	        raise ColumnarFormatError(f"dictionary overruns payload for {col.name!r}")
480	    dictionary = _decode_utf8_blob(
481	        col, rest[:dict_section_len], dict_size, what="dictionary"
482	    )
483	    index_bytes = rest[dict_section_len:]
484	    if len(index_bytes) != 4 * row_count:
485	        raise ColumnarFormatError(f"bad dictionary index length for {col.name!r}")
486	    raw_indices = struct.unpack(f"<{row_count}i", index_bytes) if row_count else ()
487	    values: list[str] = []
488	    for i, idx in enumerate(raw_indices):
489	        is_valid = validity is None or bool((validity[i >> 3] >> (i & 7)) & 1)
490	        if idx == -1:
491	            if not col.nullable or is_valid:
492	                raise ColumnarFormatError(
493	                    f"NULL dictionary index contradicts validity in {col.name!r} row {i}"
494	                )
495	            values.append("")  # replaced with None via validity bitmap below
496	        elif not 0 <= idx < dict_size:
497	            raise ColumnarFormatError(
498	                f"dictionary index {idx} out of range in {col.name!r} row {i}"
499	            )
500	        else:
501	            if not is_valid:
502	                raise ColumnarFormatError(
503	                    f"valid dictionary index in NULL slot of {col.name!r} row {i}"
504	                )
505	            values.append(dictionary[idx])
506	    return values
507

513	
514	def _stats_json(value: Any) -> Any:
515	    return value
516	
517	
518	def _build_header(
519	    table: Table,
520	    compression: str,
521	    data_section: bytes,
522	    raw_section: bytes,
523	    chunk_info: Sequence[dict],
524	) -> dict:
525	    return {
526	        "compression": compression,
527	        "row_count": table.row_count,
528	        "data_length": len(data_section),
529	        "data_crc32": zlib.crc32(data_section) & 0xFFFFFFFF,
530	        "uncompressed_length": len(raw_section),
531	        "columns": list(chunk_info),
532	    }
533	
534	
535	def _dump_json(header: dict) -> bytes:
536	    return json.dumps(
537	        header, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False
538	    ).encode("utf-8")
539	
540	
541	def _reject_duplicate_keys(pairs: Sequence[tuple[str, Any]]) -> dict:
542	    seen: set[str] = set()
543	    for key, _ in pairs:
544	        if key in seen:
545	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"duplicate JSON key in header: {key!r}")
546	        seen.add(key)
547	    return dict(pairs)
548	
549	
550	def _reject_json_constant(value: str):
551	    raise ColumnarFormatError(f"illegal JSON constant in header: {value}")
552	
553	
554	def _is_uint32(value: Any) -> bool:
555	    return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool) and 0 <= value <= 0xFFFFFFFF
556	
557	
558	def _is_nonneg_int(value: Any) -> bool:
559	    return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool) and value >= 0
560	
561	
562	def _validate_header(header: Any) -> dict:
563	    if not isinstance(header, dict):
564	        raise ColumnarFormatError("header must be a JSON object")
565	    unknown = set(header) - _HEADER_KEYS
566	    if unknown:
567	        raise ColumnarFormatError(f"unknown header key(s): {sorted(unknown)!r}")
568	    compression = header.get("compression")
569	    if compression not in _COMPRESSION_NAMES:
570	        raise ColumnarFormatError(f"unknown compression in header: {compression!r}")
571	    row_count = header.get("row_count")
572	    if not _is_nonneg_int(row_count):
573	        raise ColumnarFormatError("header row_count must be a non-negative integer")
574	    data_length = header.get("data_length")
575	    if not _is_nonneg_int(data_length):
576	        raise ColumnarFormatError("header data_length must be a non-negative integer")
577	    data_crc = header.get("data_crc32")
578	    if not _is_uint32(data_crc):
579	        raise ColumnarFormatError("header data_crc32 must be a uint32")
580	    uncompressed_length = header.get("uncompressed_length")
581	    if not _is_nonneg_int(uncompressed_length):
582	        raise ColumnarFormatError("header uncompressed_length must be a non-negative integer")
583	    entries = header.get("columns")
584	    if not isinstance(entries, list) or not entries:
585	        raise ColumnarFormatError("header must list at least one column")
586	
587	    seen: set[str] = set()
588	    next_offset = 0
589	    for pos, entry in enumerate(entries):
590	        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
591	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column header #{pos} must be an object")
592	        unknown_col = set(entry) - _COLUMN_KEYS
593	        if unknown_col:
594	            raise ColumnarFormatError(
595	                f"column header #{pos}: unknown key(s) {sorted(unknown_col)!r}"
596	            )
597	        name = entry.get("name")
598	        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name:
599	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column header #{pos}: name must be a non-empty string")
600	        if name in seen:
601	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"duplicate column in header: {name!r}")
602	        seen.add(name)
603	        col_type = entry.get("type")
604	        if col_type not in _TYPE_NAMES:
605	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {name!r}: unknown type {col_type!r}")
606	        nullable = entry.get("nullable")
607	        if not isinstance(nullable, bool):
608	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {name!r}: nullable must be true or false")
609	        encoding = entry.get("encoding")
610	        if encoding not in _ENCODING_NAMES:
611	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {name!r}: unknown encoding {encoding!r}")
612	        if encoding == "dictionary" and col_type != "utf8":
613	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {name!r}: dictionary encoding requires utf8")
614	        for key in ("offset", "length", "null_count"):
615	            if not _is_nonneg_int(entry.get(key)):
616	                raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {name!r}: {key} must be a non-negative integer")
617	        if not _is_uint32(entry.get("crc32")):
618	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {name!r}: crc32 must be a uint32")
619	        if "min" not in entry or "max" not in entry:
620	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {name!r}: min and max keys are required")
621	        if entry["offset"] != next_offset:
622	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {name!r}: chunks are not contiguous")
623	        next_offset += entry["length"]
624	        null_count = entry["null_count"]
625	        if null_count > row_count:
626	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {name!r}: null_count exceeds row_count")
627	        if not nullable and null_count:
628	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {name!r}: NULL count set for non-nullable column")
629	        _validate_stats(entry, col_type, row_count, null_count)
630	    if next_offset != uncompressed_length:
631	        raise ColumnarFormatError("declared uncompressed length does not match column chunks")
632	    return header
633	
634	
635	def _validate_stats(
636	    entry: dict, col_type: str, row_count: int, null_count: int
637	) -> None:
638	    name = entry["name"]
639	    minimum = entry.get("min")
640	    maximum = entry.get("max")
641	    if null_count == row_count:
642	        if minimum is not None or maximum is not None:
643	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {name!r}: all-NULL column needs null min/max")
644	        return
645	    if minimum is None or maximum is None:
646	        raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {name!r}: min and max must both be present")
647	    if col_type == "bool":
648	        if not isinstance(minimum, bool) or not isinstance(maximum, bool):
649	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {name!r}: bool stats must be booleans")
650	    elif col_type == "int64":
651	        if not _is_int64_json(minimum) or not _is_int64_json(maximum):
652	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {name!r}: int64 stats must be int64 integers")
653	    elif col_type == "float64":
654	        if not _is_finite_json_float(minimum) or not _is_finite_json_float(maximum):
655	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {name!r}: float64 stats must be finite numbers")
656	        minimum = float(minimum)
657	        maximum = float(maximum)
658	    elif col_type == "utf8":
659	        if not isinstance(minimum, str) or not isinstance(maximum, str):
660	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {name!r}: utf8 stats must be strings")
661	    if minimum > maximum:
662	        raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {name!r}: min exceeds max")
663	
664	
665	def _is_int64_json(value: Any) -> bool:
666	    return (
667	        isinstance(value, int)
668	        and not isinstance(value, bool)
669	        and -(2**63) <= value <= 2**63 - 1
670	    )
671	
672	
673	def _is_finite_json_float(value: Any) -> bool:
674	    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
675	        return False
676	    value = float(value)
677	    return value == value and value not in (float("inf"), float("-inf"))

681	# Writing
682	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
683	
684	
685	def write_file(
686	    path: str | os.PathLike,
687	    table: Table,
688	    *,
689	    compression: str = "none",
690	    dictionary_encoding: Sequence[str] = (),
691	) -> None:
692	    """Write ``table`` to ``path`` deterministically and atomically.
693	
694	    All validation happens before any file is created, so invalid arguments
695	    never create or alter the destination.
696	    """
697	    if not isinstance(table, Table):
698	        raise TypeError("table must be a Table instance")
699	    if compression not in _COMPRESSION_NAMES:
700	        raise ValueError(f"unknown compression: {compression!r}")
701	    if isinstance(dictionary_encoding, str):
702	        raise ValueError("dictionary_encoding must be a sequence of column names")
703	    dict_names = tuple(dictionary_encoding)
704	    if len(set(dict_names)) != len(dict_names):
705	        raise ValueError("dictionary_encoding contains duplicate column names")
706	    unknown = [name for name in dict_names if name not in table.schema.names]
707	    if unknown:
708	        raise ValueError(f"dictionary_encoding references unknown column(s): {unknown!r}")
709	    for name in dict_names:
710	        col = table.schema.columns[table.schema.index(name)]
711	        if col.type != "utf8":
712	            raise ValueError(
713	                f"dictionary encoding is only valid for utf8 columns, not {col.name!r} ({col.type})"
714	            )
715	    dict_set = set(dict_names)
716	
717	    raw_section = bytearray()
718	    chunk_info: list[dict] = []
719	    for i, col in enumerate(table.schema.columns):
720	        values = table._columns[i]
721	        payload, null_count, minimum, maximum = _encode_payload(
722	            col, values, use_dictionary=col.name in dict_set
723	        )
724	        chunk_info.append(
725	            {
726	                "name": col.name,
727	                "type": col.type,
728	                "nullable": col.nullable,
729	                "encoding": "dictionary" if col.name in dict_set else "plain",
730	                "offset": len(raw_section),
731	                "length": len(payload),
732	                "crc32": zlib.crc32(payload) & 0xFFFFFFFF,
733	                "null_count": null_count,
734	                "min": _stats_json(minimum),
735	                "max": _stats_json(maximum),
736	            }
737	        )
738	        raw_section.extend(payload)
739	
740	    if compression == "zlib":
741	        data_section = zlib.compress(bytes(raw_section), level=6)
742	    else:
743	        data_section = bytes(raw_section)
744	    header = _build_header(table, compression, data_section, bytes(raw_section), chunk_info)
745	    header_bytes = _dump_json(header)
746	    if len(header_bytes) > _MAX_HEADER_BYTES:
747	        raise ValueError("serialized header exceeds the size limit")
748	
749	    prefix = _MAGIC + bytes([FORMAT_VERSION]) + struct.pack("<I", len(header_bytes))
750	    body = prefix + header_bytes + data_section
751	    crc = zlib.crc32(body) & 0xFFFFFFFF
752	    blob = body + struct.pack("<I", crc) + _FOOTER_MARKER
753	
754	    _atomic_write(path, blob)
755	
756	
757	def _atomic_write(path: str | os.PathLike, blob: bytes) -> None:
758	    path = os.fspath(path)
759	    directory = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path))
760	    fd, tmp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".columnar-", suffix=".tmp", dir=directory)
761	    try:
762	        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as handle:
763	            handle.write(blob)
764	            handle.flush()
765	            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
766	        os.replace(tmp_name, path)
767	    except BaseException:
768	        try:
769	            os.unlink(tmp_name)
770	        except FileNotFoundError:
771	            pass
772	        raise

779	
780	def _read_exact(handle, size: int, what: str) -> bytes:
781	    data = handle.read(size)
782	    if len(data) != size:
783	        raise ColumnarFormatError(f"truncated file while reading {what}")
784	    return data
785	
786	
787	def _read_header(path: str | os.PathLike) -> tuple[bytes, bytes, dict, int]:
788	    """Read prefix + JSON header and fstat the declared total size.
789	
790	    Metadata-only: no data bytes are touched. Returns the raw prefix, raw
791	    header bytes, the validated header dict and the on-disk file size.
792	    """
793	    with open(path, "rb") as handle:
794	        prefix = handle.read(_PREFIX_LEN)
795	        if len(prefix) < _PREFIX_LEN:
796	            if not prefix:
797	                raise ColumnarFormatError("empty file")
798	            if len(prefix) >= 4 and prefix[:4] != _MAGIC:
799	                raise ColumnarFormatError("bad magic number")
800	            raise ColumnarFormatError("truncated file prefix")
801	        if prefix[:4] != _MAGIC:
802	            raise ColumnarFormatError("bad magic number")
803	        version = prefix[4]
804	        if version != FORMAT_VERSION:
805	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"unsupported format version: {version}")
806	        (header_length,) = struct.unpack("<I", prefix[5:9])
807	        if header_length == 0 or header_length > _MAX_HEADER_BYTES:
808	            raise ColumnarFormatError("header length out of bounds")
809	        header_bytes = _read_exact(handle, header_length, "header")
810	        actual_size = os.fstat(handle.fileno()).st_size
811	
812	    try:
813	        header = json.loads(
814	            header_bytes.decode("utf-8"),
815	            object_pairs_hook=_reject_duplicate_keys,
816	            parse_constant=_reject_json_constant,
817	        )
818	    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
819	        raise ColumnarFormatError(f"invalid header JSON: {exc}") from None
820	    header = _validate_header(header)
821	
822	    expected_size = _PREFIX_LEN + header_length + header["data_length"] + _FOOTER_LEN
823	    if actual_size != expected_size:
824	        raise ColumnarFormatError(
825	            f"file size {actual_size} does not match declared size {expected_size}"
826	        )
827	    return prefix, header_bytes, header, actual_size
828	
829	
830	def read_file(
831	    path: str | os.PathLike, *, columns: Sequence[str] | None = None
832	) -> Table:
833	    """Read a table, optionally projecting ``columns`` in the given order."""
834	    prefix, header_bytes, header, _ = _read_header(path)
835	    with open(path, "rb") as handle:
836	        handle.seek(_PREFIX_LEN + len(header_bytes))
837	        data_section = _read_exact(handle, header["data_length"], "data section")
838	        footer = _read_exact(handle, _FOOTER_LEN, "footer")
839	        if handle.read(1):
840	            raise ColumnarFormatError("trailing bytes after footer")
841	
842	    (footer_crc,) = struct.unpack("<I", footer[:4])
843	    if footer[4:] != _FOOTER_MARKER:
844	        raise ColumnarFormatError("bad end marker")
845	    covered = prefix + header_bytes + data_section
846	    if (zlib.crc32(covered) & 0xFFFFFFFF) != footer_crc:
847	        raise ColumnarFormatError("overall checksum mismatch")
848	    raw_section = _inflate(header, data_section)
849	
850	    schema_cols = []
851	    decoded_columns = []
852	    for entry in header["columns"]:
853	        col = ColumnSchema(entry["name"], entry["type"], entry["nullable"])
854	        schema_cols.append(col)
855	        start = entry["offset"]
856	        end = start + entry["length"]
857	        if end > len(raw_section):
858	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {col.name!r}: chunk outside data section")
859	        payload = raw_section[start:end]
860	        if (zlib.crc32(payload) & 0xFFFFFFFF) != entry["crc32"]:
861	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {col.name!r}: checksum mismatch")
862	        values = _decode_column(col, entry["encoding"], header["row_count"], payload)
863	        _verify_stats(col, values, entry)
864	        decoded_columns.append(values)
865	
866	    schema = Schema(schema_cols)
867	    table = Table._from_storage(schema, decoded_columns)
868	    if columns is not None:
869	        table = table.project(columns)
870	    return table
871	
872	
873	def _inflate(header: dict, data_section: bytes) -> bytes:
874	    if (zlib.crc32(data_section) & 0xFFFFFFFF) != header["data_crc32"]:
875	        raise ColumnarFormatError("data section checksum mismatch")
876	    if header["compression"] == "zlib":
877	        try:
878	            raw_section = zlib.decompress(data_section)
879	        except zlib.error as exc:
880	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"cannot decompress data section: {exc}") from None
881	    else:
882	        raw_section = data_section
883	    if len(raw_section) != header["uncompressed_length"]:
884	        raise ColumnarFormatError("uncompressed data length mismatch")
885	    return raw_section
886	
887	
888	def _verify_stats(col: ColumnSchema, values: Sequence, entry: dict) -> None:
889	    null_count = sum(1 for value in values if value is None)
890	    if null_count != entry["null_count"]:
891	        raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {col.name!r}: null_count mismatch")
892	    present = [value for value in values if value is not None]
893	    if not present:
894	        if entry["min"] is not None or entry["max"] is not None:
895	            raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {col.name!r}: stats mismatch")
896	        return
897	    minimum = min(present)
898	    maximum = max(present)
899	    meta_min = entry["min"]
900	    meta_max = entry["max"]
901	    if col.type == "float64":
902	        meta_min = float(meta_min)
903	        meta_max = float(meta_max)
904	    if minimum != meta_min or maximum != meta_max:
905	        raise ColumnarFormatError(f"column {col.name!r}: min/max mismatch")
906

908	def inspect_file(path: str | os.PathLike) -> dict:
909	    """Read only the file metadata; no data bytes are read, decompressed or decoded.
910	
911	    Returns a dict with fixed key order: ``format_version``, ``row_count``,
912	    ``columns``; columns stay in schema order, each with keys ``name``,
913	    ``type``, ``nullable``, ``row_count``, ``null_count``, ``min``, ``max``.
914	    """
